messages:
Noah Kim: Hey team, I'm starting parental leave 2025-09-01 and need to secure an independent caregiver contract for the first three months. Is there a way to get pre-authorization for the monthly childcare stipend so I can sign the contract?

Jordan (People Ops): Congrats Noah! We have a temporary parental-care stipend program for approved cases. Pre-authorization is possible but requires manager sign-off + a short vendor contract.

Noah Kim: What's the exact process? I need to sign by end of next week.

Jordan (People Ops): Steps: 1) Attach the caregiver contract (start/end dates, monthly fee, cancellation terms) to an email to people-ops@redwood.com; 2) your manager (Lina) must reply-all approving the spend; 3) Compensation (Tasha) will confirm stipend amount and tax handling; 4) Benefits will issue pre-authorization code and show payment options (vendor direct or reimbursed).

Lina (Manager): I approve this spend for Noah. I'll reply to the people-ops thread and confirm coverage plan.

Tasha (Compensation): Stipend rules: up to $1,500/month for up to 3 months for caregiver contracts during parental leave. Tax treatment: treated as taxable income unless the provider is an approved licensed daycare center with a W-9 and we process as vendor payment. If vendor is an individual contractor, we may need a 1099 and the amount will be reported.

Noah Kim: Vendor is an LLC in-state daycare co-op with W-9. Preferred: Redwood pay vendor directly. What's needed?

Jordan (People Ops): For direct vendor payment: vendor invoice + W-9 + bank ACH details. Finance will run vendor onboarding (supplier form). If onboarding delays risk contract deadlines, we can do reimbursement to you after you pay, then set up vendor payment for subsequent months.

PayrollBot: FYI: If processed as employee reimbursement it may be taxable and appear on next paycheck. Direct vendor payments processed as supplier costs will not flow through payroll but will require supplier setup.

Tasha (Compensation): Action: Noah submit contract + invoice + W-9; Lina confirm approval in thread (done); People Ops to open Benefits ticket; Finance to start supplier form. We'll aim for vendor payment in one pay cycle if docs complete this week.

Noah Kim: Uploading docs now. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :thumbsup:
